description: The wind: noise through a band-pass filter whose centre and level rise with the apparent wind at the masthead, so it swells as the gusts do, full at 34 knots. A storm's howl: above howl.from the centre rises further, by howl.centre times at howl.full. The breath is a made-up swell on top, as deep as perGust times the wind's gust factor over 1, at most most: none in a steady wind. Speeds in m/s, frequencies in Hz, levels as gains.
